test_cases.title: Idempotent partial-payload upsert leaves omitted types untouched
test_cases.given: a valid non-revoked ingest token whose allowed_program_ids includes the target program_id and program_artifacts already holds a row for user_story from an earlier ingest
test_cases.when: POST /api/ingest/artifacts is called twice with an identical partial-canonical-types payload (prd + test_case only)
test_cases.then: the response is 200 both times, prd and test_case rows are upserted with the given counts and as_of_timestamp, no duplicate rows exist for (program_id, type), and the pre-existing user_story row is unchanged (neither zeroed nor deleted)
test_cases.objective: Verify AC-1 (happy-path upsert), AC-5 (same-payload idempotency: no duplicates, identical end state) and AC-6 (partial-payload semantics: omitted canonical types are preserved) in a single integration flow against a real Postgres transaction.
preconditions: API service running against a real Postgres test database with the BED-01 program_artifacts table present (unique (program_id, type))
An ingest_tokens row seeded with a known bearer, not revoked, not expired, allowed_program_ids = ['prog-ing03-a']
program_artifacts pre-seeded with one row: (program_id='prog-ing03-a', type='user_story', count=7, as_of_timestamp=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z)
_ACCEPTED_KINDS includes 'artifacts' (ING-03-FR-1 extension already landed in this PR)
steps: Issue first POST /api/ingest/artifacts with Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN_PROG_ING03_A> and JSON body {program_id, kind:'artifacts', counts:{prd:3, test_case:12}, as_of:'2026-09-13T10:00:00Z'}
Query program_artifacts WHERE program_id='prog-ing03-a' ORDER BY type
Issue an identical second POST /api/ingest/artifacts with the same headers and body
Capture second response status and body
Re-query program_artifacts WHERE program_id='prog-ing03-a' ORDER BY type
expected_results: After first POST: program_artifacts contains exactly 3 rows for prog-ing03-a — (prd, 3, 2026-09-13T10:00:00Z), (test_case, 12, 2026-09-13T10:00:00Z), (user_story, 7, 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z)
After second POST: program_artifacts contains the same 3 rows with identical values (no duplicates, no new rows for arch_diagram or api_spec, user_story row still (7, 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM program_artifacts WHERE program_id='prog-ing03-a' returns 3 in both post-POST snapshots

test_cases.title: Auth and canonical-type denial matrix (401 / 403 / 400) writes zero rows
test_cases.given: a running API with an ingest_tokens row for bearer token T_A scoped to allowed_program_ids=['prog-scoped'], and a program_artifacts table with no rows for the targets under test
test_cases.when: three requests are issued against POST /api/ingest/artifacts: (a) no bearer header, (b) bearer T_A targeting program_id='prog-other' not in its allowed list, (c) bearer T_A targeting 'prog-scoped' with counts containing an unknown type key 'design_doc'
test_cases.then: responses are 401, 403 and 400 respectively, no row is written for any of the three attempts, and no partial commit occurs
test_cases.objective: Verify AC-2 (missing/invalid token → 401 per ingest-token-auth), AC-3 (out-of-scope program_id → 403 per ingest-token-auth), and AC-4 (non-canonical type key → 400, zero writes) in one denial-matrix run, and confirm NFR-security bearer-token-only + program-scoped-authorization behaviour end-to-end against a real DB.
preconditions: API service running against a real Postgres test database
ingest_tokens row seeded: token T_A, hash matches known bearer, not revoked, not expired, allowed_program_ids=['prog-scoped']
steps: Case (a): POST /api/ingest/artifacts with no Authorization header and case_a_body; capture status
Case (b): POST /api/ingest/artifacts with Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN_T_A> and case_b_body (program_id='prog-other'); capture status
Case (c): POST /api/ingest/artifacts with Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN_T_A> and case_c_body (counts contains non-canonical key 'design_doc'); capture status
Query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM program_artifacts WHERE program_id IN ('prog-scoped','prog-other')
expected_results: Row count for program_id IN ('prog-scoped','prog-other') = 0 (no partial write for case (c) — the valid 'prd' key must not commit when 'design_doc' is rejected)
No row exists for type='design_doc' anywhere in program_artifacts (canonical-type set is closed)

coverage_audit.coverage_cap_note: Manifest capped at 2 test cases by explicit user override. All 6 ACs are covered. The uncovered ids require additional dedicated TCs the cap forbids: FR-5 and NFR-observability need a log-capture unit/integration TC asserting the ingest_artifacts_write allowlist ({event, program_id, token_label, types_written}) and PII absence; NFR-performance needs a type=performance TC measuring p95 < 300 ms for a ≤5-row upsert. Escalate before the Product Gate — self-correction round skipped because generating the missing TCs would violate the user cap.
